title: digitalPotentiometer
description: Digital potentiometer / digital rheostat IC (DigiPOT) component data: a CMOS resistor ladder whose tap is selected by a digital interface. It is an IC, not a resistive track: it has a supply window, a host interface, a tap count, a wiper memory and a pinout, and no shaft, travel, track material or power rating. totalResistance, resistanceTolerance and temperatureCoefficient use the same names and units as RAS potentiometer.json so a cross-family query reads the same words; wiper resistance is wiperResistance (a dimensionWithTolerance: a digital wiper is a CMOS switch with typical and maximum columns) rather than RAS wiper.resistance. The definitions are local: AAS may $ref PEAS only. The presence of the 'digitalPotentiometer' field at the top level of an AAS document discriminates the family. Temperature coefficients are in ppm/K (the RAS resistive convention); nonlinearities in LSB; harmonic distortion and log-taper steps in dB (the AAS convention); every other quantity is SI base. Pin roles use the PEAS pinFunction values terminalA / terminalB / wiper.

substitutesInfo.description: Replacement parts for this one: manufacturer-named successors and second sources (PEAS substituteInfo; same rules as every other family).

anyOf.description: A sourced part: carries its manufacturer + datasheet.
A pre-sourcing seed: an empty digitalPotentiometer object (family-wide seed convention).

datasheetInfo.title: digitalPotentiometerDatasheetInfo
datasheetInfo.description: All information extracted from the digital-potentiometer datasheet.

electrical.title: digitalPotentiometerElectrical
electrical.description: Digital-potentiometer electricals. Values are per channel (every channel of one part has the same ladder) unless the field says 'device'. One orderable code is one resistance option: totalResistance is a single value with its tolerance band, never the list of options a generic part number is offered in.

numberOfChannels.description: Number of independent resistor ladders (potentiometers or rheostats) in the package.

configuration.description: 'potentiometer' - three terminals per channel (A, B and wiper W): a voltage divider that can also be wired as a rheostat. 'rheostat' - two terminals per channel (one end and the wiper; the other end is not brought out), so it can only be a variable resistor.

numberOfPositions.description: Number of wiper positions (taps) per channel, as the datasheet states it (256 for an 8-bit part, 129 for a 7-bit Microchip part that reaches both ends, 33 for the AD5201). Resolution in bits is derived (ceil(log2(numberOfPositions))) and not stored.

totalResistance.description: End-to-end resistance R_AB of one ladder, in Ohm. For a rheostat, the full-scale resistance R_WB at the end code.

resistanceTolerance.description: Tolerance on totalResistance as a fraction (0.2 = +/-20%). Digital ladders are typically +/-20...30% unless trimmed (+/-1% parts).

temperatureCoefficient.description: Temperature coefficient of totalResistance (rheostat mode), in ppm/K.

ratiometricTemperatureCoefficient.description: Temperature coefficient of the divider ratio in potentiometer mode, in ppm/K. Much smaller than temperatureCoefficient because the ladder sections track.

wiperResistance.description: Wiper resistance R_W (switch on-resistance in series with the tap), in Ohm.

terminalVoltageRange.description: Allowed voltage on the A, B and W terminals, in V, as ABSOLUTE volts referred to ground (minimum = most negative, maximum = most positive), e.g. {-16.5, +16.5} for a dual-supply part that prints those numbers. Written only when the datasheet prints the limits as numbers: a datasheet that states the range relative to the rails (GND...VDD, VSS...VDD) gives no number to write, so the field is omitted rather than filled with a supply value.

maximumTerminalCurrent.description: Maximum continuous current through the A, B or W terminal, in A (absolute-maximum table).

maximumPulsedTerminalCurrent.description: Maximum pulsed current through the A, B or W terminal, in A, where the datasheet gives one separately.

rheostatIntegralNonlinearity.description: Resistor integral nonlinearity R-INL (rheostat mode). A dimensionWithTolerance in LSB: nominal = the typical column as a magnitude (a datasheet '±0.25' typical is written 0.25), minimum / maximum = the guaranteed limits as printed, with their signs (−2 / +2). Keeping both columns matters because the guaranteed limit is the selection number.

rheostatDifferentialNonlinearity.description: Resistor differential nonlinearity R-DNL (rheostat mode). A dimensionWithTolerance in LSB: nominal = the typical column as a magnitude (a datasheet '±0.25' typical is written 0.25), minimum / maximum = the guaranteed limits as printed, with their signs (−2 / +2). Keeping both columns matters because the guaranteed limit is the selection number.

potentiometerIntegralNonlinearity.description: Integral nonlinearity INL of the divider (potentiometer mode). A dimensionWithTolerance in LSB: nominal = the typical column as a magnitude (a datasheet '±0.25' typical is written 0.25), minimum / maximum = the guaranteed limits as printed, with their signs (−2 / +2). Keeping both columns matters because the guaranteed limit is the selection number.

potentiometerDifferentialNonlinearity.description: Differential nonlinearity DNL of the divider (potentiometer mode). A dimensionWithTolerance in LSB: nominal = the typical column as a magnitude (a datasheet '±0.25' typical is written 0.25), minimum / maximum = the guaranteed limits as printed, with their signs (−2 / +2). Keeping both columns matters because the guaranteed limit is the selection number.

taper.description: Resistance law over the codes. Absent means not sourced, not 'linear'.

logarithmicStepSize.description: Attenuation step per code of a logarithmic (audio) part, in dB.

bandwidth.description: -3 dB bandwidth of the divider at midscale, in Hz (depends on the resistance option).

totalHarmonicDistortion.description: THD of the divider at the stated signal conditions, in dB.

digitalInterface.description: Host control interface(s). 'upDown' is the increment/decrement (CS/U-D/INC) interface; 'pushButton' is the debounced manual up/down inputs.

supply.description: Supply window (AAS supply). quiescentCurrentPerChannel is written only where the datasheet states a per-channel figure; digital potentiometers normally print a device figure, which goes in supplyCurrent instead. The two never appear together.

supplyCurrent.description: Device supply current I_DD (all channels, interface idle), in A: the datasheet's device figure, typical column. Never derived from or divided into a per-channel figure (the interface draws current whatever the channel count). Mutually exclusive with supply.quiescentCurrentPerChannel, so the supply current is never modelled twice.

digitalSupplyVoltage.description: Separate logic / interface supply voltage, in V, on parts with a VLOGIC pin.

allOf.$comment: supplyCurrent (device figure) and supply.quiescentCurrentPerChannel (per-channel figure) describe the same current; a record carries at most one of them.

memory.title: digitalPotentiometerMemory
memory.description: Where the wiper setting lives across a power cycle. A CLOSED oneOf discriminated by a pinned `type` const: a volatile part has a power-on position and no write endurance; a non-volatile part has a storage technology and an endurance. Absent means not sourced.

oneOf.title: volatileMemory
oneOf.description: Wiper register only; the setting is lost at power-down and the wiper returns to a fixed power-on position.

powerOnPosition.description: Wiper position at power-on as a fraction of full scale (0 = zero scale, 0.5 = midscale, 1 = full scale).

oneOf.title: nonVolatileMemory
oneOf.description: The setting is stored and restored at power-on.

technology.description: 'eeprom' / 'flash' - rewritable; 'oneTimeProgrammable' - a fuse that is blown once (ADI OTP); 'multipleTimeProgrammable' - a fixed number of fuse writes (ADI 50-TP).

writeEndurance.description: Number of writes the memory is rated for (1 for OTP, 50 for a 50-TP part, about 1e5...1e6 for EEPROM).
